overall_assessment: No personal data or administrative dates are left in any of the 28 plans: the Kontaktinformasjon cut removes every coordinator and teacher name, including names with particles ('[navn]'), and the 'Undervisningsstart' lines and session semester labels ('- Høst 2019') go, while both 'Vurderingsordning:' schemes now stay (the earlier greedy session cut is fixed). Across all 5,538 NTNU offerings, course_plan has 0 e-mails, phone numbers, contact blocks, 'Undervisningsstart' lines, semester-year labels or academic years. Every contact block ends at 'Ansvarlig enhet'/'Eksamen' and holds only labels, names and 'Kontaktinformasjon for dette emnet mangler.' The only staff-like name left ('Professor [navn]', ET6204) is a compendium author in Kursmateriell and is correctly kept. All 20 flags are false alarms. The 4 'removed' flags are short pages where the name list is a large share of the text. The 16 'name_like' flags come from exam-tab terms ('Eksamenssystem Inspera Assessment', 'Karakter Bokstavkarakterer'), statistical tests (Durbin-Watson, Breusch-Pagan), a reference editor (M.A. Flower) and organisation names (St. Olavs Hospital); a stoplist for these terms in R/audit/prepare_anonymization.R would cut that noise. Two cosmetic leftovers remain.

findings.evidence: det emnet som er avlagt sist. [−Andre sider om emnet−] Faglærers emneside Fagområder Biofysikk og medisinsk
findings.description: The handler strips the heading of NTNU's 'Andre sider om emnet' link box but keeps its only content, the link label 'Faglærers emneside' (the teacher's course page; its URL is already gone). It is a link label, not plan text or personal data, and now stands alone between the credit-reduction box and 'Fagområder'. The rubric counts it as boilerplate the handler targets, and the 2026-10-13 rule in methods.qmd removes link labels the same way ('Kopier lenke'). It is in 4 of 28 packet courses (FY8918 both years, ØK8000, SPRÅK8863) and in 153 of 5,538 NTNU offerings.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_ntnu(): stringr::str_remove_all("Andre sider om emnet\\s*") removes only the box heading; nothing in R/ matches 'emneside'.
findings.suggested_fix:
In .anon_ntnu(), extend the rule to the link label: stringr::str_remove_all("Andre sider om emnet\s*(?:Faglærers emneside\s*)?"). Add the FY8918 shape ('…avlagt sist.
Andre sider om emnet
Faglærers emneside
Fagområder') to the NTNU case in tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R. Rebuild and explain the metrics_check rows (153 offerings' course_plan get shorter).

findings.evidence: Emnet foreleses annethvert år, neste gang. Innholdet i kurset kan variere … neste [−gang høsten 2007.−] gang.
findings.description: 'neste gang høsten 2007' is a semester label with a year, so removing the date is correct by the rubric. But the generic season rule removes only 'høsten 2007', which leaves the sentence 'Emnet foreleses annethvert år, neste gang.' ('next time.') with the clause cut off and its label left dangling. This is in 1 of 28 packet courses and in 26 of 5,538 NTNU offerings (PG8301, and MA3060/MA3061 2013-2020: 'Emnet gis annethvert år, neste gang.'). The useful fact, that the course runs every other year, survives.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic(): the season+year rule (.season_regex followed by \\d{4}) removes 'høsten 2007' but not the 'neste gang' that introduces it.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the clause with its label before the season rule, in .anon_generic() (the wording is not NTNU-specific): stringr::str_remove_all(paste0(",?[ \\t]*(?i:neste gang)[ \\t]+(?i:", .season_regex, ")[ \\t]*\\d{4}\\b")). Then 'Emnet gis annethvert år, neste gang høsten 2016.' becomes 'Emnet gis annethvert år.' The rule removes only an admin date and its label, which fits course_plan_spec.md. Add both sentences to tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R.
